violation_type.title: Field Trips -First Aid Kit (26 TAC §747.2901(a)(4))
violation_type.typical_finding: The operation does not have a first aid kit that is to be used when children are being transported.

finding_variants.text: The operation does not have a first aid kit that is to be used when children are being transported.

It was observed that during a field trip to park located across the street the director did not have a first aid kit available.      Note:  Corrected at Inspection when director gathered his first aid kit, and stated that he will put the first aid kit in the carry case.
The first aid kit was missing a thermometer and scissors. **These were provided by the provider and placed in the first aid kit in the vehicle.
